description: Vina reference: co-crystal ligand redocked into the staged pocket — the binding-affinity floor that any generated molecule must beat to claim a hit (TODO-22 metric #1 denominator).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric reference floor (TODO-22 metric #1) — Phase-1B pocket 3ny8
source: Co-crystal ligand (HETATM residue JRZ, 20 heavy atoms) extracted from PDB 3ny8 and redocked at exhaustiveness=8, n_poses=1.
notes: Co-crystal ligand (residue JRZ) extracted from 3ny8.pdb HETATM lines; coords written to a PDB file and prepared via meeko.mk_prepare_ligand.
Reference score: -7.14 kcal/mol at exhaustiveness=8, n_poses=1, box center at the ligand heavy-atom centroid + box side = max(20, 2*r+16) A.
High-affinity / triple-threshold / relaxed-success metrics (#3, #4, #5) are computed against this floor on pocket 3ny8.
